title: Wild Geodude switches to nearer reachable Cargo without canceling its Walk

verification.actor: One current Wild Geodude, a Wild Cyndaquil, and a Wild Weepinbell on Route29 with a passive Cyndaquil follower.
verification.trigger: Geodude captures normal Player Interest and claims first Cargo during an accepted northward Walk. A nearer passive Cargo then spawns without altering any claim, timer, profile or motion.
verification.observable: The same full Geodude switches its Cargo binding to the nearer current reachable Weepinbell, releases the first claim, and keeps Player Interest. Its accepted Walk finishes normally. It then physically picks the nearer Cargo, keeps one HELD owner, and launches it with a normal Hop. The passive follower is present but never a substitute for either named Cargo.
